title: Credit Department Terms of Account for the Feed Ledger
content:
Terms of payment, the unpaid balance a programme will carry, the charges that attach to an overdue invoice and the ways money may reach the cooperative are terms of the individual programme within the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes.

| Programme | Terms, in calendar days from the invoice date | Unpaid balance the programme will carry | Late charge | Grace, in calendar days after the due date | Service charge on an overdue balance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | 0 | $0.00 | $15.00 | 10 | 1.50 percent a month |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | 15 | $15000.00 | $15.00 | 10 | 1.50 percent a month |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | 15 | $35000.00 | $15.00 | 10 | 1.50 percent a month |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | 20 | $80000.00 | $25.00 | 10 | 1.25 percent a month |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | 20 | $150000.00 | $25.00 | 10 | 1.25 percent a month |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | 15 | $60000.00 | $25.00 | 10 | 1.50 percent a month |

## Ways of paying

| Programme | Ways the member may pay | Grain settlement proceeds may be credited to the feed account |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | check, credit card | no |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | check, ACH, credit card, grain settlement transfer | yes |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | check, ACH, grain settlement transfer | yes |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | check, ACH, grain settlement transfer | yes |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | check, ACH, grain settlement transfer | yes |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | check, ACH, grain settlement transfer | yes |

## The terms in words

The Bagged Feed Cash Account carries no terms and no balance at all. The limits above it rise from fifteen thousand dollars on the Bulk Delivered Feed Account to a hundred and fifty thousand on the Full Nutrition Partner Program, with sixty thousand on the Medicated Feed VFD Program and eighty thousand on the Contracted Ingredient Program. Grace is the one figure common to all six programmes at ten calendar days. The late charge is fifteen dollars on the three lowest-limit programmes and twenty-five on the Contracted Ingredient Program, the Full Nutrition Partner Program and the Medicated Feed VFD Program, while the monthly service charge is one and a quarter percent on the two contracted-ingredient programmes and one and a half percent on the other four.

A check is taken on every programme. ACH is taken on every programme except the Bagged Feed Cash Account. A credit card is taken only on the Bagged Feed Cash Account and the Bulk Delivered Feed Account. Grain settlement transfer is open on every programme except the Bagged Feed Cash Account, which is the one programme on which settlement proceeds may not be credited to the feed account.
